info.title: vantage
info.description: A terminal console for Claude Code sessions and git worktrees on Windows.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A console for Claude Code sessions and git worktrees on Windows.

commands.name: here
commands.description: Start a supervised Claude Code session in this folder, on its current branch, and attach to it in this tab. Ctrl+Z detaches; the session keeps running.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: An opening prompt to send; without one the session opens on Claude's agent list.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The session's name; the folder's name when left out.

commands.name: setup-terminal
commands.description: Add the Vantage and Vantage session profiles to Windows Terminal, each with a bell that sounds and flashes, then offer to turn on Claude Code's terminal bell. Shows what it will write and asks first.

options.name: --sound
options.description: The bell sound of the Vantage profile.

options.name: --session-sound
options.description: The bell sound of the Vantage session profile.

commands.name: claim-tab
commands.description: Run by the shell inside a tab Vantage opened, to claim that tab.
